controller: Frozen qualified CPU teacher; not trained Kev

simulation_protocol.action_semantics: native-adjacent-tile-entry-v2; whole native frames, no changed physics
simulation_protocol.stop: win = first native level clear; death = native game-over after all initial/bonus lives; continue after intermediate deaths. Large watchdog bounds detect stalled runs and never count as wins.
simulation_protocol.loop_definition: repeated position sequence of period 2..64 with at least 2 distinct tiles, within one life and without consuming a pellet
simulation_protocol.loop_streak_definition: Consecutive decisions satisfying loop_definition. A non-cycle decision, pellet consumption or new life resets the streak. Report all raw cycles and the longest streak separately.
simulation_protocol.avoidable_death_definition: chosen action loses a life before entering the requested adjacent tile, while another legal action from identical native state and RNG does not; no claim of eventual survival
simulation_protocol.censoring: watchdog exits are stalled/incomplete failures, never wins or native game-overs; report separately and reject for teacher qualification
simulation_protocol.split_rule: seeds reserved for evaluation, disjoint from every packaged v1 data split; never use their trajectories for new training
simulation_protocol.generalization_scope: same classic maze, starting levels 1,2,3,5 and five seeds (20 full games per adapter); no held-out-layout or untested-level claim

future_rng: Independent fixed planning scenarios [11117,77717]; no actual future episode RNG lookup
scope: Exact same 20 reserved starts as native-v2/v3, same protocol. Finite benchmark evidence, not universal safety or optimality.

older_qualification_suite.purpose: Freeze the teacher algorithm/options/source; separate from the newly run500xx paired reference.

aggregate_definitions.totals: Sum of additive metrics across the20 games.
aggregate_definitions.means: Mean of episode metrics; dry/streak means average the per-game maxima.
aggregate_definitions.maximum_longest_no_pellet_decisions: Maximum of the per-game longest intervals.
aggregate_definitions.pellets_per_native_active_frame: Total pellets collected divided by total active native simulation frames.
